verdict.rationale: Asking for AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product is a fair question for a chat and community platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any first-party AI insights, summaries or suggestions feature in Discord. The developer APIs for bots, commands and integrations are building blocks that a developer could use to construct such a feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
